title: Step 8: Docs & examples
summary: README (install, quickstart, memory types, scoping, lifecycle) + one runnable example per adapter.
description:
Write the README (install, quickstart with docker Db2, the four memory
types explained, scoping model, lifecycle features) and one runnable
example per adapter under examples/. Keep examples short — under 50 lines
each, showing store setup, a remember() call, and a recall() call.

Before starting: read DECISIONS.md in full — the README should reflect it
accurately, not the original Step 0 aspiration if anything changed along
the way.

comments.text: Done. Rewrote root README.md end-to-end (the old file was a stub — a one-line description plus "Full documentation added in Step 8"), reading project-management/DECISIONS.md in full first so the docs reflect the SDK's actual current scope rather than the Step 0 aspiration: it now documents all five memory types (working, episodic, semantic_facts, entity_profiles, procedural) instead of the original four, and covers every feature added since — confidence scoring (ENH-1), content-hash dedup (ENH-2), Reconciler/soft-supersession (ENH-3), claim-based async consolidation + consolidate_every_n (ENH-4), context cards (ORC-1), content chunking (ORC-2), structured metadata filters (ORC-3), SchemaPolicy.REQUIRE_EXISTING (ORC-4), and RRF hybrid retrieval (PIPE-1). README sections: install (base + langchain/openai-agents/mcp/all extras), a Docker Db2 quickstart (icr.io/db2_community/db2:12.1.5.0, --privileged, Apple Silicon note, migration run + remember/recall snippet), a memory-types table, the MemoryScope hierarchy (tenant_id > agent_id > user_id > thread_id), a lifecycle-features section (TTL, forget/purge_expired, optimistic-concurrency versioning, consolidation, reconciliation, confidence), a known-limitations section carried over from the VER-13 market-fit gap table (erasure convenience API, bi-temporal reasoning, token-budget compaction, per-process consolidation cadence), and links to examples/ and project-management/. Added examples/ with four scripts, each under 50 lines and each following store-setup -> remember() -> recall(): core_sdk_example.py (plain MemoryStore, SemanticFact + store.facts.search()), langchain_example.py (Db2ChatMessageHistory.add_message() + store.working.search()), openai_agents_example.py (async Db2Session.add_items() + store.working.search()), and mcp_example.py (create_server(store) plus the same store.remember()/store.working.search() calls the MCP remember/recall tools make internally). All four use a shared zero-dependency deterministic pseudo-embedding (examples/_embedding.py) so they need no API key, and all four were verified with py_compile. Added examples/README.md as an index. This closes the sole hard blocker identified in the 2026-08-02 Beta Readiness Report (VER-13/EPIC-4) for worldwide public beta release.
